summary: BUTIKKDRIFT BRODALEN AS (org. no. 936 441 831) is a private limited company (AS) based in Lillehammer, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2025-10-24. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 47.110 (Detaljhandel med bredt vareutvalg med hovedvekt på nærings- og nytelsesmidler); it has 31 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was -NOK 569. CEO: Fredrik Hagen Brodalen; board chair: Fredrik Hagen Brodalen.
